title: VERIFY T-440: replay the rehearsal from clean and try to falsify its scorecard
description: Different agent from T-440's producer. Run the rehearsal fresh, check every fired entry against the raw evidence independently, neuter 3 mechanisms in a temporary copy and confirm the scorecard stops reporting them fired, and confirm the live tree and secret material were untouched.
acceptance_criteria: Verifier is a different agent from T-440's producer.
The rehearsal is run fresh from a clean checkout state; the scorecard is reproduced.
Every fired entry is checked against the raw evidence by reading the sandbox files directly, not the scorecard's own summary.

In a temporary copy, 3 mechanisms are neutered one at a time (for example: phase B yield never emitted; forks returns nothing; a case cannot be disposed by citation). For each, the rehearsal must stop reporting that mechanism fired. Record the result per mutant.
The live tree is untouched (git status and the .harness sha256 manifest), no warrant was signed, the operator key was not read, and no private key from the live .harness/keys was copied.
Verdict recorded with evidence; T-440 marked done or sent back to open.

notes.note: T-441 IS the verification task for T-440, executed and closed by verifier-g9-rehearsal (distinct from T-440's producer worker-g9-rehearsal). Evidence recorded on T-440's own note: fresh replay reproduced the scorecard (fired=8/blocked=4/unbuilt=1, live untouched YES); every fired row checked against raw sandbox files (tasks/cases/deliberations/precedents/events.jsonl/acts) directly, not the scorecard summary; 3 mechanisms neutered one at a time in throwaway scratchpad copies (phase_b_yield log_event call, precedent.py cited_by append, blackboard.py producer!=approver guard) and each neutering flipped its row from FIRED to BLOCKED; live tree confirmed untouched via git status --porcelain + sha256 manifest diff (only gitignored logs/transcript.jsonl, from my own session hook, differed); no warrant.py call anywhere in the script, live .harness/keys/* and ~/.ssh/harness_root mtimes unchanged (predate this run), no absolute user path leaked. Full suite via goal_mode.py: GOAL REACHED iteration 1/3. T-440 marked done.
